title: [BUG] LinearFunctionForZeroStage3 crashes with torch.func transforms (missing setup_context)
author: roycho96

comments.author: zhangj1an
comments.body:
Hey maintainers, I reproduced this error locally. Can this issue be assigned to me? 

On top of what @roycho96 mentioned for  `LinearFunctionForZeroStage3`, we also need to apply the same change (`forward(ctx, …)` → `forward` + `setup_context`) for `PostBackwardFunctionModule` and `PreBackwardFunctionForModule` in `deepspeed/runtime/zero/parameter_offload.py`. 

I think dropping support for PyTorch < 2.0 would need a separate PR to update`setup.py`, docs, release notes. So for this PR I’ll just keep both version with a version check. 

I will also add a small regression unit test for this bug. 

Thanks in advance!

Hi @zhangj1an, thanks for pointing out the other functions and the backward compatibility part!

I've opened a draft PR ([#7916](https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/7916)) with the fix for `LinearFunctionForZeroStage3` including the PyTorch version check. Feel free to push commits directly to this branch for the `parameter_offload.py` changes. Happy to collaborate on this.
